one_liner: Cloud web scraping and automation platform built around serverless Actors.

evidence.claim: API token authentication via Authorization Bearer header (recommended) or URL token query parameter
evidence.quote: Add the token to your request's `Authorization` header as `Bearer <token>`. E.g., `Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxx`.

evidence.claim: API token is self-serve, found in the Apify Console Integrations settings
evidence.quote: You can find your API token on the [Integrations](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations) page in the Apify Console.

evidence.claim: Free plan available without a credit card, covering most platform features
evidence.quote: We offer a free plan that lets you use most of the features of the Apify platform, but with certain limits. No credit card is required.

evidence.claim: API is RESTful HTTP with JSON responses and a downloadable OpenAPI schema
evidence.quote: The Apify API is built around HTTP REST, uses predictable resource-oriented URLs, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes

evidence.claim: Apify officially documents and ships its own MCP server for AI agents
evidence.quote: MCP Discover and use Actors with AI agents and LLMs via Apify MCP server.

notes: Official MCP server lives at mcp.apify.com with source in the apify GitHub org (apify/apify-mcp-server). Also supports 'agentic payments' (x402 protocol PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header and Skyfire skyfire-pay-id header) letting AI agents pay for Actor runs without an Apify account. Official API clients exist for JS, Python, Go, Java, Rust, .NET, PHP. Token-in-URL query param auth is supported but flagged as less secure.
